plan_item: 77.44.7.A — layout.display tablet lifecycle across editable PARTIAL types
finding: The responsive layout.display field had representative and 18-layout-type tablet coverage, but no full lifecycle across all 44 editable PARTIAL types.
change: Added tests/browser/editor-inspector-display-tablet-partial-types.test.js and regenerated docs/evidence/feature-traceability.json from its canonical generator. Runtime source and public assets did not change.
coverage: All 44 editable PARTIAL types receive distinct desktop/tablet/mobile display values from the real Inspector, cycling through block, flex, grid, inline, and none. The test checks responsive.set/display routing, Canvas CSS, exact raw display values in the Page Model, draft Save and Editor reload, public snapshot isolation before Publish, separate Publish, desktop/tablet/mobile inheritance, mobile reset to tablet and tablet reset to desktop, and Save versus Publish for each reset.
css_context: The published page root is a flex container. CSS blockifies inline-level display values for flex items, so the test compares the stored raw inline value to the Page Model and expects the public computed value to be block when the parent formatting context is flex/grid. This is CSS layout behavior, not a source/runtime defect.
